meta.title: Specimen Sorter API
meta.subject: lis-crs-spec-ack-svc — one POST to auto-register or send out from a USID
meta.author: LIS Team

slides.headline:
One POST on Specimen Acknowledgement
registers or sends out a USID
slides.lede: Sorter middleware calls lis-crs-spec-ack-svc. Flex packing, alerts, and hard checks move behind that call. Staff Spec Ack stays as the fallback.
slides.footer: Design reviewed by Tony Chong  ·  reference SEM20260612  ·  production JIRA not assigned
slides.notes: Cover is identity only. Production JIRA is not assigned; TMP-000 is the dossier stand-in. Reference SEM20260612. Tony Chong reviewed the design note.

slides.title: The sorter needs the staff click path in one call

steps.title: Staff scan and click
steps.body: Staff scan a USID on Specimen Acknowledgement, then click Send-out or Register.

steps.title: Writes are already in the service
steps.body: Lookup and writes live in the Spec Ack service. Packing still sits in Flex.

steps.title: One call, then a bin
steps.body: The sorter must bin the tube from one LIS response in under four seconds.

callout.lead: Do not use the staff GET:
callout.text: GET /retrieveGcrOrder hard-codes user ltc611. Do not call it.

slides.notes: Writes are not the gap. Middleware cannot call /gcrSpecAckRegister without the packing object the screen builds today.

slides.title: Packing still lives on the screen

left.label: Today
left.title: Screen owns the contract
points: Staff click send-out or register with that packing
Workbench comes from the PC login

right.label: Proposed
right.title: One new POST
points: Convertor, validator, and ALS alerts run on the server
Reuse retrieve, sendOutSpecimen, register, worksheet, PHLC
Staff APIs stay as they are

callout.text: Do not overload /gcrSpecAckRegister or the ECPath5 register. Both keep the wrong caller contract.

slides.notes: Overloading /gcrSpecAckRegister would keep the staff packing contract. Overloading ECPath5 register would keep a hard-coded user. The convertor has to move or the caller invents a second packing shape.

slides.title: A new POST orchestrates retrieve, convert, then write

fallthrough.label: No
fallthrough.title: FAILURE
fallthrough.body: Unknown sorter, APS/BBS/MBS, mixed tests, STAR 4422

terminal.label: No
terminal.text:
SEND_OUT if all tests
in LOE_SENDOUT_TEST
else REGISTERED

condition.label: Also on this path
condition.note: Do not compare workbench lab to the retrieved test lab. Print only after REGISTERED.

slides.notes: STAR with no wkbh_location is Failure 4422. Mixed local and send-out is Failure, not ALS. DFT uses the same Spec Ack register() packing.

slides.title: The Flex convertor moves behind the API

code.caption: Grouping, USID as request no., and ward/doctor mapping must exist before register().

findings.title: Defaults replace checkboxes
findings.body: Ack time is server now. AAR off. Urgent workstation off. Labels off. No relabel checkbox.

findings.title: register() already expects this
findings.body: Porting only the validator still leaves an empty test-group list.

findings.title: Ro builders stay with print
findings.body: Worksheet, send-out form, and SH Ro are built here, printed only after Registered.

slides.notes: register() already assumes this packing. Skipping the convertor and porting only the validator still leaves an empty test-group list.

slides.title: Print only after Registered

takeaways.title: Late print is allowed
takeaways.body: A late worksheet does not change a REGISTERED status already returned.

takeaways.title: Print all, no picker
takeaways.body: Staff worksheet picker is gone. Every Ro from the convertor prints.

slides.notes: Spec Ack sendOutActions never prints. The ack auto-print flag is not used. Staff picker goes away: print all on the registration path.

slides.title: Seed user, workbench, and map, then deploy

cards.title: Create the sorter user
cards.body: Dedicated LIS user on LOE_AUDIT_TRAIL. Not ltc611.

cards.title: Seed a workbench row
cards.body: One row per sorter: hosp, lab, station name, location, printer.

cards.title: Insert the map row
cards.body: Sorter id, user, workbench id, lab, hosp, server name.

cards.title: Deploy and open the path
cards.body: Deploy lis-crs-spec-ack-svc. NetworkPolicy only. No API key in v1.

callout.text: Add SORT_* to the Audit Trail filter. Still write REG and SEND_OUT.

slides.notes: Printer and STAR location come from workbench, not copied onto the map. Audit workstation is wkbh_station_name. Pilot CPS and HMS; Relabel and Failure bins go back to staff Spec Ack.

slides.title: Stop middleware. Staff Spec Ack is unchanged

cards.title: Stop middleware
cards.body: Staff clicks still retrieve, send-out, and register. The staff APIs are untouched.

cards.title: Drop the map table
cards.body: DROP TABLE loe_sorter_map on full rollback. Leave or disable the workbench and user.

cards.title: No history rewrite
cards.body: Do not convert historical requests. Fallback is operational, not a data rewrite.

slides.notes: The staff path is the fallback. Drop only the map table. Workbench and user can stay inactive.

slides.title: Four decisions to ratify before build

asks.q: Leave v1 with NetworkPolicy only, no API key or Hub JWT?
asks.why: Same isolation as Spec Ack today (D1).

asks.q: Fail the tube when the USID has both local and send-out tests?
Print worksheets and PHLC only after Registered, after HTTP return?
Show SORT_* actions on the Audit Trail filter?

callout.text: Requester already answered D1-D11. This room ratifies.

slides.notes: Requester already answered D1-D11. This room is the ratification, not a new design pass.

slides.headline: Q&A
slides.notes: Likely questions: why not overload /gcrSpecAckRegister; why DFT skips /api/dftreg; why workbench lab is not checked against the test lab.

slides.headline: Target latency
slides.note: About 20 specimens a minute per lab in v1. Worksheet and PHLC sit after the sorter wait path.
